Künzle * This person is not on ResearchGate, or hasn't claimed this research yet. ## Abstract In this paper we study different models of the Teichmüller space of compact hyperbolic surfaces with special emphasis on their construction by geodesic octagons. Such surfaces have become increasingly interesting due to their applications to the physical behavior of chaotic quantum systems.
